entities.name: Operator-defined access category
entities.description: Access category definitions configured by the operator via NAS signaling, consisting of precedence value, category number (32-63), criteria types/values, and optional standardized access category.

entities.name: Access category criteria
entities.description: Criteria consisting of one or more access category criteria types and associated values used to match access attempts.

entities.name: DNN criteria type
entities.description: Access category criteria type based on Data Network Name matching during PDU session establishment or for existing sessions.

entities.name: S-NSSAI criteria type
entities.description: Access category criteria type based on Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information matching during PDU session establishment or for existing sessions.

entities.name: OS Id + OS App Id criteria type
entities.description: Access category criteria type based on operating system and application identifiers triggering the access attempt.

entities.name: Access category 7 (MO_data)
entities.description: Standardized access category used as fallback when operator-defined category definitions cannot be used or recognized.

entities.name: PDU session establishment
entities.description: Procedure to establish a new PDU session, triggering access attempts that can match operator-defined access categories.

entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: Procedure to transition UE from 5GMM-IDLE modes to 5GMM-CONNECTED mode, which can trigger access attempts matching operator-defined categories.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: UE state where access control is performed for operator-defined access categories only for specific events.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: UE state where access control is performed for operator-defined access categories only for specific events 1-8.

relations.description: Operator-defined access category definition includes criteria consisting of access category criteria types and values.
Access category criteria can include DNN as a criteria type for matching access attempts.
Access category criteria can include S-NSSAI as a criteria type for matching access attempts.
Access category criteria can include OS Id + OS App Id as a criteria type for matching access attempts.
PDU session establishment access attempts are evaluated against DNN criteria if DNN matches access criteria values.
PDU session establishment access attempts are evaluated against S-NSSAI criteria if S-NSSAI matches access criteria values.
When operator-defined category cannot be used or recognized, UE falls back to access category 7 (MO_data) for RRC establishment cause determination.
Access control using operator-defined categories in 5GMM-IDLE mode is performed only for specific events defined in subclause 4.5.1.
Access control using operator-defined categories in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode is performed only for events 1-8 defined in subclause 4.5.1.
Service request procedures triggered by PDU session establishment/modification/release can match operator-defined access category criteria.
